_about: Recorte congelado em 2026-11-17 das bases steel_sm.db e pulp_paper.db (IABr e SECEX/MDIC, dados publicos), periodos 2024-07 a 2026-09. Gerado por make_fixture.py (scratchpad da sessao). Gabarito: o PDF IABr_3Q26 do time.

iabr_consumption.ddl:
CREATE TABLE iabr_consumption (
        period TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        year INTEGER, month INTEGER,
        total REAL, flat REAL, long_prod REAL,
        updated_at TEXT
    )

iabr_domestic_sales.ddl:
CREATE TABLE iabr_domestic_sales (
        period TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        year INTEGER, month INTEGER,
        total REAL, flat REAL, long_prod REAL, semi REAL,
        updated_at TEXT
    , slabs REAL, billets REAL)

iabr_exports.ddl:
CREATE TABLE iabr_exports (
        period TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        year INTEGER, month INTEGER,
        flat_ktons REAL, long_ktons REAL, semi_ktons REAL,
        total_ktons REAL, total_usd_mn REAL,
        updated_at TEXT
    )

iabr_imports.ddl:
CREATE TABLE iabr_imports (
        period TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        year INTEGER, month INTEGER,
        flat_ktons REAL, long_ktons REAL, semi_ktons REAL,
        total_ktons REAL, total_usd_mn REAL,
        updated_at TEXT
    )

iabr_production.ddl:
CREATE TABLE iabr_production (
        period     TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
        year       INTEGER, month INTEGER,
        crude_steel REAL, flat REAL, long_prod REAL,
        semi REAL, slabs REAL, billets REAL, pig_iron REAL,
        updated_at TEXT
    )

secex_imports.ddl:
CREATE TABLE secex_imports (
        period   TEXT,
        category TEXT,
        revenue_usd_mn REAL, volume_ktons REAL,
        price_usd_ton  REAL, working_days INTEGER,
        yoy_revenue REAL,   yoy_volume REAL,
        updated_at TEXT,
        PRIMARY KEY (period, category)
    )

secex_exports.ddl:
CREATE TABLE secex_exports (
        period   TEXT,
        category TEXT,
        revenue_usd_mn REAL, volume_ktons REAL,
        price_usd_ton  REAL, working_days INTEGER,
        yoy_revenue REAL,   yoy_volume REAL,
        updated_at TEXT,
        PRIMARY KEY (period, category)
    )

secex_country.ddl:
CREATE TABLE secex_country (
        period       TEXT,
        direction    TEXT,
        category     TEXT,
        country      TEXT,
        volume_ktons REAL,
        revenue_usd_mn REAL,
        updated_at   TEXT,
        PRIMARY KEY (period, direction, category, country)
    )

secex_iron_ore.ddl:
CREATE TABLE secex_iron_ore (
        period TEXT, direction TEXT, product TEXT, country TEXT,
        volume_ktons REAL, revenue_usd_mn REAL,
        PRIMARY KEY (period, direction, product, country)) WITHOUT ROWID

import_prediction.ddl:
CREATE TABLE import_prediction (
        period  TEXT,
        product TEXT,
        country TEXT,
        value_usd REAL,
        volume_kg REAL,
        updated_at TEXT,
        PRIMARY KEY (period, product, country)
    )

pred_exports.ddl:
CREATE TABLE pred_exports (
        period     TEXT,
        country    TEXT,
        product    TEXT,
        value_usd  REAL,
        volume_kg  REAL,
        updated_at TEXT,
        PRIMARY KEY (period, country, product)
    )

secex_pulp_country.ddl:
CREATE TABLE secex_pulp_country (
        period TEXT NOT NULL, year INT, month INT, country TEXT NOT NULL, product TEXT NOT NULL,
        volume_ktons REAL, revenue_usd_mn REAL,
        PRIMARY KEY (period, country, product)) WITHOUT ROWID

secex_pulp_port.ddl: CREATE TABLE secex_pulp_port (period TEXT, year INT, month INT, port TEXT, volume_ktons REAL, revenue_usd_mn REAL)

calendar.ddl: CREATE TABLE calendar (period TEXT, year INT, month INT, working_days INT)
